theorems.hypotheses: finite non-negative rational W partitioned into stable internal block A and retained boundary B, with W=[[A,X],[Y,B]]
theorems.statement: With S_I=(I-A)^-1 and W_eff=B+Y S_I X, full W is stable iff W_eff is stable. On the stable phase the full star restricted to retained boundary equals (I-W_eff)^-1; det(I-W)=det(I-A)det(I-W_eff); Z_loop(W)=Z_loop(A)Z_loop(W_eff).
theorems.path_semantics: Each effective boundary transition is the positive recoalescence of a direct boundary edge and every complete internal excursion with no intermediate boundary visit.

theorems.hypotheses: same module scope as T30; future finite non-negative rational context may add port-port, port-external, external-port and external-external edges but no direct hidden-internal edges
theorems.statement: Replacing the hidden module by W_eff preserves composite stability and every stable visible port/external star entry in every allowed context. Therefore all visible feedback-event kernels, feedback interactions and critical radii computed from those star entries are exactly preserved.
theorems.gauge_composition: Positive state gauge restricts to positive diagonal similarity on W_eff; Schur elimination is associative under stable sequential elimination.

theorems.hypotheses: baseline-stable modules with the same labeled port set; observer sees stable/unstable status and stable visible star for every allowed finite positive-rational port context
theorems.statement: Two modules are port-dynamically contextually equivalent iff their W_eff matrices are equal. If the observer additionally sees absolute full global loop-zeta, the complete exact signature is (W_eff,Z_int) with Z_int=1/det(I-A). For context-induced Gamma/zeta increments only, Z_int cancels and W_eff alone remains sufficient.
theorems.minimality: Necessity follows from the empty context: the stable port star determines W_eff=I-S_port^-1; once W_eff is known, empty-context full zeta determines Z_int.

negative_boundaries.statement: Total-mass Schur collapse can identify modules with different path count, dominant-path mass or provenance. Equal W_eff does not imply equal CWM/provenance data.

The port signature is exact only for contexts that cannot directly mutate or connect to hidden internal states/couplings. Richer observers or hidden-state operations require a richer signature. Signed/amplitude, complex and infinite-state contexts remain outside scope.
